Name: POSTURE_CONTROL_PARAM_PRO_ST
Description: Arm posture twist from the equipped chest armour, used to keep arms clear of bulky armour. Row ID = posture type × 100 + the chest armour's Posture Control ID; posture type is 0 normally, 1 while riding Torrent and 2 while in stealth (crouching). Each aNNN group is picked by the active weapon motion category (as in PostureControlParam_WepRight); categories without a group get no twist, and a missing row gives 0. Values are the maximum twist: the behaviour script scales them by a weight set by the current animation's TimeAct events and eases toward the result (up to 90 per second).

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Arm - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Arm sideways (inside/outside) twist. This param is its only source, and it applies in every stance (one-handed and two-handed). Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Right arm forward/back twist. Combined with the weapon's value (PostureControlParam_WepRight): the one with the larger magnitude is used. When one-handing, using paired weapons or riding it moves the right arm forward/back; when two-handing it raises/lowers both arms. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Read by the game, but the retail behaviour script doesn't apply it (the sideways twist comes from Right Arm Inside/Outside). Retail mirrors the right-arm value. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Left arm forward/back twist. Combined with the weapon values (PostureControlParam_WepRight while two-handing, PostureControlParam_WepLeft otherwise): the one with the larger magnitude is used. Applied only when one-handing, using paired weapons or riding. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.
